p9_b0.ocr: In the Managed Care Enrollment data for Philips Healthcare as of December 2023, the total enrollment across regions shows North Europe with a count of 15,000 and a percentage of 35%, South Europe with 12,000 and 28%, West Europe with 18,000 and 42%, and East Europe with 16,000 and 38%. By plan type, HMO has 9,000 enrollees at 60%, PPO has 6,000 at 50%, EPO has 7,200 at 40%, and POS has 4,800 at 30%.

p9_b1.ocr: The total enrollment is 61,000, representing 100%, while total plans count at 28,800, or 47%. The demographic breakdown includes 32,000 at 52%. Enrollment growth stands at 8%, with the previous year at 56,000 and total revenue at €500M, total expenditures at €450M, net profit at €50M, and a profit margin of 10%. In the Patient Satisfaction Index, overall ratings indicate Inpatient Care at 85.0, Outpatient Care at 88.5, Telehealth Services at 90.2, and Emergency Services at 76.3.
